conviction_note: Balanced: the guidance bar has been lowered (brokers expect the FY27 top end trimmed to 2.5%) and every tier-1 peer print this month was bought, but the ADR is already +24% over 20 days and +7.3% over 5, sits near the Rs 1,186 consensus target, short interest has already fallen 16% since August, and the put skew is +5 vol points; findings sum to 0.0 and p_up 50 x abs 7.0 gives 0.0.
bar: Q2 FY27 CC revenue +1.1-1.7% QoQ (PL/Kotak 1.1%, Emkay 1.5% USD), Bloomberg consensus net sales Rs 49,108 cr, PAT Rs 7,904 cr, EBIT margin 21.2% (https://www.businesstoday.in/markets/stocks/story/infosys-q2-results-dividend-earnings-expectations-timing-fy27-guidance-targets-563068-2026-10-22 ; https://www.tradingview.com/news/moodys:5f90fa053e78c:0-infosys-q2-revenue-growth-likely-to-remain-modest-analysts-see-guidance-cut/). Company guide FY27 CC +1.5-3.0%, EBIT 20-22% (set 2026-07-23, https://upstox.com/news/market-news/earnings/infosys-q1-results-fy-27-revenue-growth-guidance-narrowed-to-1-5-3-0-in-constant-currency/article-197461/); Street expects a trim of the top end to 1.5-2.5% (Emkay, JM Financial) or a narrowing to 2-3% (HDFC); large-deal TCV bar $2-3bn vs $3.6bn in Q1. Revenue bar sourced to two or more agreeing sources; the guidance bar is dispersed.
positioning_check: Short interest on the INFY ADS 108.98M shares at the 2026-09-30 settlement, 7.39 days to cover, down from 125.12M (2026-09-15) and 129.80M (2026-08-31) (https://equibles.com/stocks/infy/shortinterest, read 2026-10-22); the 10-15 figure is not yet published. Much of this is likely ADR/local arbitrage rather than outright bearish. Skew: 25d put minus call +5.08 vol points, put/call OI 1.21, so downside is paid. Tape: run_up_20d +24.0%, run_up_5d +7.34%, still 35.6% below the 52-week high. Event-implied move 7.22%.

findings.finding: The FY27 guidance bar has been lowered: the company guide is +1.5-3.0% CC (narrowed from 1.5-3.5% on 2026-07-23), and the 2026-10-22 brokerage previews expect a trim to 1.5-2.5% (Emkay; JM Financial 2026-09-28 the same) or a narrowing to 2-3% (HDFC). Meanwhile the Q2 consensus of +1.1-1.7% QoQ CC sits at or above the 0.5-1.4% CQGR ask rate the current guide implies (PL, July). So holding the range or narrowing it upward would beat the expected trim, and a trim to 2.5% at the top is roughly what the Street already holds.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The ADR traded on the guide each time. 2026-01-14: guide raised to 3-3.5%, ADR +10.45% (https://finance.yahoo.com/news/infosys-infy-soars-10-45-100957350.html). 2026-04-24: first FY27 guide 1.5-3.5% read as cautious, NSE down as much as 4.87% intraday. 2026-07-23: top end cut to 3.0%, ADR -4.92% at 09:44 ET (https://www.rttnews.com/3670054/infosys-q1-net-profit-rises-revises-fy27-revenue-outlook-stock-down.aspx). October 2025: guide raised to 2-3%, NSE still -2%.
findings.why_not_priced: The previews converge on a trim, so a held or upward-narrowed range is not the consensus case. If the market had priced a hold, the put skew would not be +5 and the previews would not lead with 'guidance cut'. The 24% run-up does show some of the relief is already in.
findings.independence: Ask-rate arithmetic from a separate source, PL India 2026-07-24 (https://plindia.com/ResReport/INFO-24-7-26-PL.pdf), and the JM Financial expectation (https://businesstoday.in/markets/stocks/story/tcs-infosys-hcl-tech-techm-wipro-ltm-check-fresh-targets-for-top-it-stocks-ahead-of-q2-results-558244-2026-09-28). This is an inference on the guide and not a company document, so it is sized small.

findings.finding: This reporting season's reaction function has bought Indian IT prints: TCS +5.46% on 2026-10-09 (0.5% QoQ CC, in line, TCV $9.6bn), HCLTech +4-5% on 2026-10-13 (FY27 guide raised to 2.5-4%), Wipro NSE +6.5% on 2026-10-16 despite a Q3 guide of -1.5% to +0.5% and large-deal bookings -58.6%, and Tech Mahindra +7-8% on 2026-10-16. The exception was Persistent, -6% on mixed numbers.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Peer pattern, not INFY's own. INFY's own guide-day reactions this year were -5% (twice) and +10.45%.
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced: INFY's +24% 20-day and +7.3% 5-day run-up is the market already extrapolating the peer relief. What is left is the chance that the pattern of relief rallies on in-line prints carries to the last tier-1 name. Note that Wipro's ADR fell about 3% on its guide while the NSE line rose, so the ADR does not always follow.
findings.independence: Wipro: https://upstox.com/news/market-news/stocks/wipro-shares-gain-6-5-despite-a-nearly-5-qo-q-fall-in-q2-earnings-sluggish-trends-ahead/article-201988/ ; TechM: https://www.businesstoday.in/markets/stocks/story/tech-mahindra-shares-surge-as-q2-margins-beat-estimates-check-brokerage-targets-561969-2026-10-16 ; HCLTech: https://upstox.com/news/market-news/earnings/news-2-0-159/article-201706/. All are peer proxies.

findings.finding: The relief is already in the price. The ADR is +24.0% over 20 days and +7.34% over 5 days into the print. The NSE line at Rs 1,156 on 2026-10-22 is within 3% of the Rs 1,186 consensus 12-month target, which Business Today itself calls limited upside. ADR short interest has already fallen from 129.8M (08-31) to 109.0M shares (09-30), so part of the covering fuel is spent, and the 25d put-call skew is +5.08 vol points.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: 2026-07-23: the ADR fell 2.06% overnight into the print and then another 4.92% on the guide trim. 2025-10: NSE fell for a fifth day after a beat with a raised guide (-2%). The name has sold good-enough prints when it went in strong.
findings.why_not_priced: This is what IS priced. It is filed as the counterweight that a stranger reading only the peer and guidance findings would miss. If the run-up had not happened, the stock would sit near its July $10.4 level with a much lower bar for relief.
findings.independence: Short-interest series from a separate source: https://equibles.com/stocks/infy/shortinterest. Skew and run-up from the sealed baseline.

findings.finding: Counterparty demand read-through is positive. Accenture (2026-10-01) guided FY27 at +3-6% local currency, above Street, with Q4 bookings of $22.2bn. HCLTech (2026-10-12) raised its FY27 CC guide to 2.5-4% from 1-4% with $3.26bn of new bookings. Both spoke after Infosys last did, on 2026-07-23.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: INFY ADR moved on peer reads before: +40% intraday spike on 2025-12-19 around the Accenture print (per the Infosys statement reported by letsdatascience). Its own guide-day moves are in finding 1.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced, since both were public weeks ago and INFY rallied through them. What remains is whether management echoes it in the guide, which the trim-expecting previews do not assume.

findings.finding: Counterparty demand read-through is negative. Wipro's 2026-10-15 Q3 guide is -1.5% to +0.5% QoQ CC, IT services were flat QoQ in Q2, and large-deal bookings fell 58.6% to $674M. Wipro's ADR fell about 3% on the guide. This points to H2 furlough and discretionary softness, the line JM says Infosys's H2 commentary will be judged on.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: INFY's July trim was attributed to a soft macro environment and program terminations, and the ADR fell 4.9%.
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced: the NSE line of Wipro rallied anyway and INFY kept rising after it. It matters only if Infosys's H2 commentary echoes it.
findings.independence: Wipro guide and bookings detail: https://ticker.finology.in/discover/market-update/wipro-q2-fy27-results-analysis. The same company, so this is one finding.

findings.finding: On 2026-10-08 the US Department of Labor suspended new and pending PERM (green-card labor certification) applications for eight firms including Infosys, citing alleged visa-programme misuse. Infosys filed a 6-K company statement dated 2026-10-10 (filed 2026-10-13) saying it does not anticipate a material impact. Its safe-harbor language now names 'pending litigation and the US government investigation' (the DOJ H-1B classification probe disclosed in October 2025).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No prior print turned on immigration. TCS (reporting the same day as the suspension), HCLTech and Wipro all rallied on their prints after it, and the INFY ADR rose about 5.3% on 2026-10-13.
findings.why_not_priced: Largely priced, because peers traded through it. The residual is call-time commentary on US delivery cost, local hiring or onsite mix in the H2 outlook, which no preview models.

findings.finding: The board meets 2026-10-22/23 to consider an interim dividend (last year's interim was Rs 23/share). Capital return is expected, and no buyback is announced or reported.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No resolved Infosys reaction is attributable to the interim dividend.
findings.why_not_priced: In the wire; only an unexpected size or a buyback would add anything.

baseline_tension: The peer reaction pattern and the lowered guidance bar lean up, but the +5.08 put skew and the +24% 20-day run-up both lean down, so the evidence offsets and p_up sits at 50.
lessons_applied: Rule 7 (sign against skew): the guidance-hold finding goes against a +5 put skew with only inference as the reason the market is wrong, so it is cut from +1.0 to +0.8
Rule 5 (proxy): the peer reaction-function finding is a peer proxy, so it is cut from +0.8 to +0.6
Rule 3 (caveat reaches the number): baseline_tension says the evidence cuts against the skew and run-up, so p_up moves from 52 to 50 and expected_move_pct from +0.28 to 0.0

Final rule (history from wrong events): the reaction base rate was rebuilt from confirmed releases (Jan +10.45% ADR, Apr about -5% NSE, Jul -4.9% ADR, Oct 2025 -2% NSE); abs_move_pct stays at 7.0, beside the 7.22% implied move
